description: Unit tests for D3D11 video device format support checking in the media namespace, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: FormatSupportCheckerUnittest
classes.description: Test fixture class for format support checker tests.

methods.name: NullDeviceDoesntCrash
methods.description: Tests that initializing with a null device does not crash and returns false.

methods.name: CheckInitializationCantCast
methods.description: Tests that initialization succeeds when device query interface returns a mock video device.

methods.name: CheckFormatSupportWorks
methods.description: Verifies that format support check returns true when both enumerator and device support the format.

methods.name: CheckFormatSupportRequiresBoth
methods.description: Ensures that support check returns false if either enumerator or device does not support the format.
